author: Jeronetj3
body:
I’m sorry to say but it’s not 181% (I know for sure because that would have made it ornate)

I can tell which one of the Robes it is (there are four Robes but two of them have negative Resistance and one is red instead of black) I checked the website and this one is 163%

I’d say maybe worth fully upgrading to 10 but definitely not worth MF'ing it

author: permaculturegeek
body:
It can be handy gear, especially if you use several pieces and let all those buffs add up. I've used the T5 (4?) and T8 versions for Othersouls quite successfully. My main opponent uses the same follower as me (Bashe) at T8/9, but thanks to the beast taming, his hardly ever acts.

Also, now that you've killed him, that king will turn up frequently in dungeons and monuments for the rest of the event.

author: petr1petr
body:
this is pretty good for lacuna build. I mean - it is better to use helm and boots, so that you can use armor for element boost, but if you are missing helm/boots, this will do.

quality does not matter too much - you are after the assassin boost - amount of slots also counts, so GF is not bad idea.
